However the justification seems to weigh future benefits: "将来利益を確保" - securing future profits. So likely long-term oriented: maybe 4 or 5. Given the scale 1-5, 5 is long-run 5-10+. 4 is long-term but not super long. They mention future profits but not extremely long? They still accept short-term red. So maybe 4.
